_about: Membership discounts. Add a membership here and it appears in the page's membership menu; no code change needed. Each discount names the venue ids it applies to and either amount_off (CAD) or percent_off. applies_to says which prices it reduces: "rate_card" (prices from a venue's general rate card, price_confidence "estimated"), "venue_stated" (a price the venue stated for that screening, price_confidence "scraped"), or "all". When several ticked memberships apply, the page uses the one that saves most; prices never go below $0.
